purpose: Correlate backboardd command-buffer commit, scheduling and completion with Turnip pass/submission timing and cadence-b display arrival, fence and latch timing.
expected_diagnostics: SHENG_DIAG enables the existing backboardd frames.trace writer, frontend command stages, Turnip pass stamps and submission ring.
SHENG_GPU_TRACE adds render, encode and completion thread identities to the kernel GPU ring for correlation with display arrival, fence and latch.
The existing Metal telemetry table reports aggregate commit-to-complete histograms and recent command records to unified logging every 30 seconds.
limits: A successful RECOVERY upload and a boot to the 21H461 desktop do not establish GPU tracing on this board: the ring has no reader here, so this image produced no command-buffer or pass timing. Any further GPU work must either build a reader for this device or measure through the syslog path that cadence-b already exercises.

device_result.boot: Recovery 03cb927a booted the 21H461 desktop and restored paired USB (05ac:12ab).
device_result.reason: The kernel GPU ring this image enables has no consumer on this board. The reference reader lives in the reference device repository and pulls its files through a Linux log image the board does not build; no scripts/decode-gpu-trace.py exists in this repository or UniXNU. The packaged frontends only push records into the ring, and the backboardd frames.trace file it writes under /private/var/mobile/Library/Caches/com.apple.backboardd/m2v/ has no retrieval channel on this device.
device_result.consequence: The pipeline-refusal and GPU-wait evidence in this area comes from the cadence-b syslog capture, not from this image. Do not enable gpu-trace again until a reader exists on this board.
